meta.title: Appendiceal neoplasms in silico decision trainer
meta.condition: Appendiceal epithelial neoplasms (LAMN/HAMN, mucinous and non-mucinous adenocarcinoma, goblet cell adenocarcinoma) and pseudomyxoma peritonei, adult
meta.population: Adults with appendiceal epithelial neoplasms - THE INCIDENTAL DIAGNOSIS: ~0.9% of appendectomies harbor a tumor (verified, 7,970-appendectomy series), most found after an operation done for appendicitis - so the first decision is usually retrospective: what does the specimen demand next? GRADE IS DESTINY is the spec's router (PSOGI consensus, verified): low-grade disease (LAMN; low-grade mucinous carcinomatosis) runs a years-to-decades tempo where surgery cures and chemotherapy has a RANDOMIZED receipt for futility; high-grade disease (HAMN's descendants, invasive adenocarcinoma, signet-ring, goblet-cell) runs on the colorectal-adjacent clock with imported systemic tools. Appendiceal NETs - the MOST COMMON appendiceal tumor (42 of 74 in the verified series) - are a DIFFERENT entity honestly blocked (no trainer exists; the ENETS size rules carried in the gate note). The colorectal trainer is next door and its imports are labeled as imports.
meta.summary: Evidence-linked teaching application for the registry's final queued row - the incidental diagnosis where grade is destiny. THE RANDOMIZED NEGATIVE RECEIPT anchors the low-grade chapter: the MD Anderson crossover trial (n=24; its attribution CORRECTED by the sweep from the briefing's 'Choti/NCI' - the fourth premise correction of this stack; its PubMed PMID itself resisted matching and is cited by journal/DOI, flagged) found ZERO objective responses, NO tumor-growth difference between chemotherapy and observation, and WORSE quality of life on chemo - fluoropyrimidine chemotherapy does not shr…
meta.disclaimer: Synthetic teaching environment. Not medical advice; every number is a claim with a citation and an expiry date.
meta.classification: PSOGI modified Delphi consensus (Carr 2016, PMID-verified): LAMN / HAMN / mucinous adenocarcinoma (infiltrative invasion required) on the primary side; acellular mucin / low-grade / high-grade / high-grade-with-signet-ring mucinous carcinoma peritonei on the peritoneal side - with the Ronnett-to-PSOGI validation receipt matched; WHO5 digestive tumours (book-grade, secondhand) adopts the same architecture plus goblet cell ADENOCARCINOMA (a carcinoma, not a NET, despite the legacy 'carcinoid' name - the terminology trap said); the HAMN term exists only post-2016 (do not backfill older literature)
meta.response: The completeness-of-cytoreduction (CC) score is THE prognostic artifact of the peritoneal chapter (CC-0/1 vs 2/3 - the dominant multivariate factor in the 2,298-patient registry, verified paper); tumor markers (CEA/CA19-9/CA125) + CT rhythms at consensus grade; the tempo honesty: low-grade disease recurs over years to DECADES (the 430-patient recurrent-PMP receipt verified) and surveillance never truly ends

Newly diagnosed.name: Appendectomy alone (LAMN, confined - the operation already done)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: the confined-LAMN standard (Chicago Consensus verified; NCCN-in-colon-guideline secondhand)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: consensus-grade completion logic on verified consensus documents; the figure flagged
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: none further - the operation already happened for appendicitis
Newly diagnosed.patient: For the slow-growing type fully contained in the removed appendix: the surgery you already had is very likely the whole cure - what remains is a careful, long calendar of checkups.

Newly diagnosed.name: Right hemicolectomy (invasive adenocarcinoma / goblet-cell - the staging operation)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: the invasive-disease standard (Chicago Consensus verified; GCA debate carried)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: consensus + series (verified receipts); adjuvant content imported and labeled as such
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: a colectomy's ledger + the imported adjuvant's where used
Newly diagnosed.patient: For the invasive types: one more operation - removing the right portion of the colon to check the lymph nodes - with chemotherapy afterward only if the nodes say so, borrowed honestly from the colon cancer playbook.
drugs: Right hemicolectomy (+ imported adjuvant per nodes)

Newly diagnosed.name: CRS +/- HIPEC (the peritoneal chapter - decade receipts at specialized centers)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: the peritoneal standard at specialized centers (Chicago Consensus verified)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: 2,298-patient registry (verified) - series-grade by necessity, with the no-RCT honesty and non-transfer trap said
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: a major multi-visceral operation - the recovery craft is months, spent against a decade-scale payoff
Newly diagnosed.patient: For disease on the belly's lining that can be removed: the big specialized operation - clearing everything visible, often with heated chemotherapy washed inside - with the best long-term numbers in this disease: most patients alive beyond ten years in the largest study.

Newly diagnosed.name: Observation-first, low-grade unresectable (the negative trial, honored)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: observation-first per the randomized receipt - the evidence, not a compromise
Newly diagnosed.evidence: randomized crossover (verified result; PMID flagged) + corroborating series (verified) - the negative trial honored
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: none from therapy - which the trial showed is the point
Newly diagnosed.patient: For the slow form when the big operation isn't possible: careful watching - because a proper randomized study showed chemotherapy did not slow this disease at all and made life worse; watching IS the evidence-based treatment, with re-checks for whether surgery becomes possible.
drugs: Active observation + interval reassessment (trial doors offered)

Newly diagnosed.name: Systemic therapy, high-grade unresectable (the colorectal import, said)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: the colorectal import (consensus-grade, said as imported)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: imported extrapolation (no appendiceal RCT) - labeled by origin
Newly diagnosed.patient: For the faster form when surgery isn't possible: the colon cancer drug playbook, borrowed honestly - plus two dedicated studies that deliver treatment directly into the abdomen.

Newly diagnosed.name: Comfort-focused care
Newly diagnosed.guideline: always on the menu, never by drift
Newly diagnosed.patient: Comfort-focused care is a real choice - with a team experienced in this disease's specific needs.

Relapsed / recurrent.name: Iterative CRS (recurrence in the low-grade decades)
Relapsed / recurrent.guideline: the recurrent-low-grade convention at specialized centers (series verified)
Relapsed / recurrent.evidence: 430-patient series (verified receipt); the flagged median says teaching estimate
Relapsed / recurrent.toxicity: another major operation - candidacy is the craft
Relapsed / recurrent.patient: If the slow form returns - even years later - another clearing operation is often possible and effective: surgery remains this disease's real medicine.

Relapsed / recurrent.name: Progressive high-grade disease (the imports and the IP doors)
Relapsed / recurrent.guideline: imported later lines + dedicated regional doors
Relapsed / recurrent.evidence: imported (said) + trial doors at their grades; the shelf dated
Relapsed / recurrent.patient: For the faster form progressing after treatment: the borrowed later-line drugs plus two studies delivering treatment directly into the abdomen - with one important honesty: the mucus-dissolving drug in the news is not yet available in the US.

Connor et al. 7,970-appendectomy series (Dis Colon Rectum 1998 - PMID 9510314, pubmed-url-match): 74 tumors = 0.9%; NETs the most common (42/74) - the incidental-diagnosis and NET-frequency receipts | PMID 9510314 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

The Chicago Consensus on peritoneal surface malignancies: management of appendiceal neoplasms (Cancer 2020 - PMID 32282073, pubmed-url-match; the suite verified: Standards 32282066, Methodology 32282063, Introduction 32282062, NET chapter 32282069) - the completion logic's home: confined-LAMN appendectomy-alone; RHC for invasive disease. The Govaerts PSOGI/EURACAN guideline (EJSO 2021;47:11-35) citation-corroborated, its PMID FLAGGED | PMID 32282073 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25
Chicago Consensus standards chapter (PMID 32282066, pubmed-url-match) - the specialized-center imperative's consensus home | PMID 32282066 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

Chua et al. Early- and long-term outcomes of CRS/HIPEC for PMP of appendiceal origin (JCO 2012;30:2449-56 - PMID 22614976, pubmed-url-match): 2,298 patients, multi-institutional registry - 63% ALIVE BEYOND TEN YEARS (the registry's longest verified number); CC score the dominant multivariate factor (factor-level detail memory-grade); the ~196-month median and low-grade-subset figures memory-grade, FLAGGED; conclusion: 'specialized unit setting' | PMID 22614976 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

THE NON-TRANSFER TRAP, twice-caught: PRODIGE-7 (CRS +/- oxaliplatin-HIPEC in COLORECTAL peritoneal metastases; null OS - Quenet, Lancet Oncol 2021;22:256-66; citation corroborated, the trial's PMID NEVER url-matched: FLAGGED - and the sweep caught the adjacent comment 33476594 posing as it AND ICARuS's PMID falsely offered as it by a search summary). It does NOT transfer to appendiceal disease (different biology, mitomycin practice) - the warning editorials VERIFIED: 'Beware mis-representation' (31522482) + 'Limitations' (33932372). No HIPEC-vs-none RCT exists in appendiceal disease (negative claim, stated as one; Sugarbaker 1995 peritonectomy citation corroborated, PMID FLAGGED) | PMID 31522482 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

THE RANDOMIZED NEGATIVE RECEIPT: efficacy of systemic chemotherapy in low-grade mucinous appendiceal adenocarcinoma - randomized crossover (MD ANDERSON - the attribution CORRECTED by the sweep from the briefing's 'Choti/NCI': the stack's FOURTH premise correction; JAMA Netw Open 2023;6:e2316161 / NCT01946854; PMC-verified, the PubMed PMID resisted matching - FLAGGED, cited by journal/DOI): n=24 - ZERO objective responses; NO tumor-growth difference chemo vs observation; QoL WORSE on chemo. Chemotherapy does not shrink mucin - randomized-grade, and honored: no chemo is carded for low-grade disease

refs.label: Corroborating receipts (both matched): NCDB chemo-efficacy-by-grade analysis (26506400) + negative impact of systemic therapy before CRS/HIPEC in low-grade disease (39500859, 2024) | PMID 26506400 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

THE GCA DEBATE on three verified receipts: the Tang classification/spectrum (Am J Surg Pathol 2008 - 18685490, matched); the 2024 systematic review (39202258, matched: 6 studies, n=3,177 - RHC-favoring survival signal, no consensus-quality comparative data); the NCDB omission-may-be-safe counterpoint (34409541, matched). RHC is the standard; the debate is live; both said. GCA is a CARCINOMA (the terminology trap - ENETS excludes it) | PMID 39202258 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

Appendiceal NETs - the DIFFERENT entity (most common appendiceal tumor per Connor): ENETS 2023 guidance (PMID 37682701, pubmed-url-match) + the Chicago NET chapter (32282069, matched) - size rules: <1 cm appendectomy; 1-2 cm completion only with risk factors; >2 cm RHC. No NET trainer exists - blocked honestly; the ENETS 2016 paper's PMID unmatched (superseded anyway)

Managing recurrent PMP in 430 patients (PMID 34041626, pubmed-url-match) - the long-clock and iterative-CRS receipt: late recurrence over years-to-decades, often still operable | PMID 34041626 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

The optimal post-treatment surveillance-imaging question (PMID 38749003, pubmed-url-match - title matched including its 'peritoneii' spelling): the consensus rhythm (CEA/CA19-9/CA125 + CT) has no trial-grade answer, said | PMID 38749003 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

THE COLORECTAL IMPORT, said: high-grade appendiceal adenocarcinoma takes FOLFOX/FOLFIRI-family regimens per colorectal extrapolation - no appendiceal-specific RCT exists (consensus-grade via Chicago 32282073; NCCN-in-colon-guideline secondhand). The co-naming pattern: peritoneal-directed trials now explicitly name appendiceal alongside colorectal; pure systemic CRC baskets stay silent - and the negative crossover readout is the argument against silent lumping for low grade

Smeenk et al. population-based study (EJSO 2008 - PMID 17524597, pubmed-url-match): PMP incidence ~2 per million/year (NL); 0.9% of 167,744 appendectomies had a lesion; mucinous neoplasm in 0.3%, ~20% of whom developed PMP - the epi receipts, source-marked | PMID 17524597 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

NCCN: appendiceal adenocarcinoma addressed within the Colon Cancer guideline (dedicated section in recent versions) - SECONDHAND, DATED; no dedicated NCI PDQ appendiceal summary confirmed (likely absent, unverified negative)

THE SHELF, dated: ICARuS (NCT01815359, EPIC vs HIPEC after CRS, MSK) ACTIVE-NOT-RECRUITING with est. completion 2026-09 - READOUT IMMINENT (flag for spec refresh); BromAc (NCT03976973 - 81% mucolysis phase 1) runs in AUSTRALIA/SPAIN with NO US site (orphan designation only) - the honest not-here answer; non-US 2025-26 items noted (Chinese 1-vs-3-HIPEC RCT; two capecitabine-PMP studies, locations unverified)

El-Jawahri A, LeBlanc T, VanDusen H, et al. Effect of Inpatient Palliative Care on Quality of Life 2 Weeks After Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation: A Randomized Clinical Trial. JAMA 2016;316(20):2094-2103 (PMID 27893130, NCT02207322) — abstract read firsthand 2026-09-10. POPULATION CAUTION, added at that read because the previous label named no population at all: this is a SINGLE-INSTITUTION randomized trial of 160 adults with HAEMATOLOGICAL malignancy hospitalized for autologous or allogeneic stem-cell transplantation, and its outcomes are quality of life, depression, anxiety, fatigue and symptom burden — it reports no survival and no adverse-event table. It is the factory's standing anchor for the PRINCIPLE that palliative care runs alongside active treatment rather than after it; it is not evidence in this tumour type and is not the source of any number on this card.

NIH SMART (NCT04847063): CRS+HIPEC with ex-vivo drug-response testing - appendiceal named (PCI <= 30, ECOG <= 1); NIH Clinical Center single-site; PHASE-DESIGNATION AMBIGUOUS across sources (flagged) - WEB-VERIFIED 2026-08-20 (registry-verify 2026-03), re-check due.
